title: What actually goes wrong when you hardcode a proxy creation code
summary: The assumption behind a hardcoded proxyCreationCode constant is that a wrong value will announce itself. It does not. It produces a valid, fundable address that no transaction on any chain can ever deploy to.
author: farbodghasemlu

title: What actually costs time in browser post-quantum encryption
summary: The common objection to post-quantum cryptography in the browser is that lattice schemes are too slow for client-side use. Measured against a working implementation, that objection is misdirected.
